title: Offline fallback page
description: Display a branded offline page when the user has no network connection instead of the default browser error screen. Improves perceived quality and reinforces the PWA feel.
acceptance_criteria: Service worker intercepts navigation requests and serves offline.html when fetch fails
Offline page shows app name, logo, and a retry button that reloads when back online
Cached conversations are still accessible and listed on the offline page

title: Add to Home Screen install prompt
description: Intercept the beforeinstallprompt event and show a contextual in-app banner prompting Android Chrome users to install the PWA. Increases retention by surfacing the install path at the right moment.
acceptance_criteria: Banner appears after user sends their second message if not already installed
User can dismiss the banner permanently (stored in localStorage)
Clicking install triggers the native prompt; success/failure is tracked in telemetry

title: Web Share API for conversation snippets
description: Allow users to share individual AI responses or selected conversation snippets via the native OS share sheet using the Web Share API. Makes it easy to send useful answers to other apps.
acceptance_criteria: Share icon appears on hover/long-press of any assistant message bubble
Shared content includes message text and a short app attribution line
Falls back to clipboard copy with toast notification on unsupported browsers

title: Keyboard shortcut help overlay
description: Show a modal overlay listing all keyboard shortcuts when the user presses Cmd+K or ? from the chat input. Reduces discovery friction for power users.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay opens on Cmd+K (Mac) / Ctrl+K (Win) and on ? when input is not focused
All existing and new shortcuts are listed with platform-aware key labels
Overlay is dismissible with Escape and clicking outside; fully keyboard-navigable

title: Export conversation as Markdown or JSON
description: Let users download the current conversation session as a .md or .json file from the session options menu. Enables backups and integration with note-taking tools.
acceptance_criteria: Export option appears in the session context menu with format choice (MD / JSON)
Markdown export preserves code blocks, headers, and bold/italic formatting
JSON export includes all message metadata (role, timestamp, model, telemetry)

title: Image attachment support for vision models
description: Allow users to attach images that are encoded as base64 and sent in the multimodal message format supported by OpenAI GPT-4o, Gemini, and Anthropic Claude vision models. Unlocks a major use-case for these providers.
acceptance_criteria: Paperclip button in the input bar opens a file picker filtered to image types
Selected image is shown as a thumbnail preview before sending
Base64 image payload is included only when the active model advertises vision capability; unsupported models show a clear warning

title: System prompt and persona customization
description: Provide a per-session system prompt editor accessible from session settings so users can define personas, tone, or domain constraints. Persisted in IndexedDB alongside the session.
acceptance_criteria: System prompt textarea is available in session settings drawer
Prompt is prepended as the system role message on every API call for that session
A set of quick-start persona templates (e.g. Coding Assistant, Translator) is available

title: Cross-session conversation search
description: Add a global search input that queries message content across all IndexedDB sessions and highlights matching results. Essential for users with many saved conversations.
acceptance_criteria: Search bar accessible from the sidebar header with Cmd+F / Ctrl+F shortcut
Results show session title, date, and a snippet of the matching message
Clicking a result navigates to that session and scrolls to the matching message

title: Swipe-to-open sidebar gesture on mobile
description: Implement a swipe-right gesture on the chat area to open the session sidebar on touch devices, mirroring common mobile navigation patterns. Reduces the need to tap a small icon.
acceptance_criteria: Swipe right from the left 20px edge opens the sidebar with a spring animation
Swipe left on the open sidebar closes it
Gesture does not conflict with horizontal scrolling inside code blocks

title: Improve system dark mode auto-sync
description: Ensure the color scheme switches immediately when the OS theme changes at runtime via the prefers-color-scheme media query, without requiring a page reload. Polishes the existing partial implementation.
acceptance_criteria: matchMedia listener updates data-theme attribute and localStorage preference in real time
Theme toggle button state stays in sync with the current active theme
No flash of incorrect theme on initial load for any combination of system preference and saved preference

title: Lighthouse PWA score: reach 100
description: Audit and remediate all Lighthouse PWA checklist items to achieve a perfect PWA score. Validates the app meets installation and reliability standards across browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse PWA audit returns 100 in CI on every main-branch deploy
All required manifest fields (icons at 192 and 512, display, theme_color) are present
maskable icon variant is included in the manifest

title: Accessibility audit and ARIA remediation
description: Conduct a full WCAG 2.1 AA audit covering ARIA labels, keyboard navigation order, focus management, and screen reader compatibility. Makes the app usable for users relying on assistive technology.
acceptance_criteria: axe-core automated scan reports zero critical or serious violations
All interactive elements have visible focus indicators and descriptive ARIA labels
Modal dialogs and sidebar trap focus correctly and restore it on close

title: Lazy-load Prism.js and marked.js
description: Defer loading of Prism.js and marked.js until the first message containing code or markdown is rendered, reducing initial parse and execution time on slower devices.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse TTI improves by at least 200ms on a simulated Moto G4 profile
Libraries are loaded via dynamic import() and cached after first load
No visible rendering delay or layout shift when libraries load mid-session

title: IndexedDB quota exceeded error boundary
description: Detect the QuotaExceededError thrown by IndexedDB writes and present the user with a clear message and options to delete old sessions rather than silently losing data.
acceptance_criteria: All IndexedDB write operations are wrapped in try/catch for QuotaExceededError
A non-blocking toast + modal offers to delete the N oldest sessions to free space
Current in-flight message is preserved in memory and retried after cleanup

title: PWA background sync for offline queued messages
description: Use the Background Sync API to queue outgoing messages when offline and automatically replay them once connectivity is restored. Prevents message loss on unreliable connections.
acceptance_criteria: Messages submitted while offline are stored in a sync queue in IndexedDB
Background sync tag fires on reconnect and the service worker processes the queue
User sees a 'Sent' confirmation badge on previously queued messages after sync

title: Token usage and cost estimator
description: Display estimated token counts and approximate USD cost per message and per session based on the active model's public pricing. Helps BYOK users track spend before they get a surprise bill.
acceptance_criteria: Per-message token count is shown in the telemetry badge row
Session sidebar shows cumulative token count and estimated cost for each session
Pricing table is updatable without a code change (stored in a JSON config file)

title: Conversation branching and message regeneration history
description: When a user regenerates a response, preserve the previous response as an alternate branch that can be cycled through with prev/next arrows. Avoids permanent data loss on regenerate.
acceptance_criteria: Regenerated responses are stored as an array of alternates in IndexedDB
Arrow controls appear on assistant messages that have more than one version
Active alternate index is persisted so the selected version survives page reload

title: Multi-language UI coverage audit and completion
description: Audit all UI strings across EN, ZH, MS, JA, and VI locale files for missing keys and inconsistent translations, and fill any gaps. Ensures non-English users have a fully translated experience.
acceptance_criteria: Automated script compares all locale JSON files against the EN master and reports missing keys in CI
Zero missing translation keys in any supported locale on main branch
Native-speaker review sign-off documented for ZH and JA locales

title: XOR obfuscation upgrade to AES-GCM via WebCrypto
description: Replace the current XOR-based API key obfuscation with AES-256-GCM encryption using the browser's native WebCrypto API, deriving the key from a user-set PIN or device fingerprint. XOR provides no real confidentiality against anyone who reads the source.
acceptance_criteria: API keys are stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in IndexedDB; XOR code is fully removed
On first run, user is prompted to set a 4-8 character unlock PIN stored only in sessionStorage
Incorrect PIN shows an error; correct PIN decrypts keys for the session lifetime only

title: Provider health check and latency indicator
description: Show a small status dot next to the active provider selector that pings a lightweight endpoint to indicate whether the provider API is reachable and its current response latency. Helps users diagnose whether slowness is on their end or the provider's.
acceptance_criteria: Status dot is green/yellow/red based on a HEAD or lightweight API ping run every 60 seconds
Hover tooltip shows last checked time and median latency in ms
Health check respects the user's saved API key so it tests authenticated access
